question_en: Which function gives a straight line on a log-log plot?
question_uz: Qaysi funksiya grafigi log-log koordinatalarda to'g'ri chiziq bo'ladi?
question_ru: График какой функции в логарифмических координатах (log-log) является прямой?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. y = 3x² ⇒ log y = log 3 + 2 log x — og'masi 2 bo'lgan to'g'ri chiziq.
Asos: darajali qonun log-log'da chiziqli.

uz: $\log y$ va $\log x$ orasida chiziqli bog'lanish, og'ma $2$.
ru: Между $\log y$ и $\log x$ линейная зависимость, наклон $2$.
en: Take the logarithm of the power function: $$\log y=\log3+2\log x$$
$\log y$ is linear in $\log x$ with slope $2$.

distractors.B: eksponenta yarim logarifmik grafikda to'g'ri chiziq bo'ladi, log-log'da emas
distractors.C: $\ln x$ — $x$ o'qi logarifmik bo'lgan yarim logarifmik grafikda to'g'ri chiziq
distractors.D: $\sin x$ manfiy qiymatlar ham qabul qiladi, uning logarifmi har doim aniqlanmagan
distractors.E: chiziqli funksiya oddiy grafikda to'g'ri chiziq; ozod had $1$ bo'lgani uchun log-log'da egri

distractors_ru.B: экспонента — прямая на полулогарифмическом графике, а не в log-log
distractors_ru.C: $\ln x$ — прямая на полулогарифмическом графике с логарифмической осью $x$
distractors_ru.D: $\sin x$ принимает и отрицательные значения, её логарифм определён не всегда
distractors_ru.E: линейная функция — прямая на обычном графике; из-за свободного члена $1$ в log-log она кривая

distractors_en.B: an exponential is straight on a semi-log plot, not on a log-log plot
distractors_en.C: $\ln x$ is straight on a semi-log plot with a logarithmic $x$-axis
distractors_en.D: $\sin x$ takes negative values, so its logarithm is not always defined
distractors_en.E: a linear function is straight on an ordinary plot; the constant term $1$ makes it curved on a log-log plot

question_en: A radioactive sample decays with half-life $T_{1/2}$. What fraction of the nuclei remains after $3T_{1/2}$?
question_uz: Radioaktiv namunaning yarim yemirilish davri $T_{1/2}$. $3T_{1/2}$ vaqtdan keyin yadrolarning qancha qismi qoladi?
question_ru: Период полураспада радиоактивного образца $T_{1/2}$. Какая доля ядер останется через $3T_{1/2}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Har T½ da yarmi qoladi: (1/2)³ = 1/8.
Asos: N = N₀·2^(−t/T½).

uz: Har bir davrda ikki marta kamayadi: $$\frac{N}{N_0}=\left(\frac12\right)^3=\frac18$$

distractors_en.A: divided by the number of half-lives: $1/3$
distractors_en.B: $1/(2\cdot3)$ — multiplied instead of raising to a power

explanation_200:

Asos: maxsus burchaklar qiymatlari.

distractors_ru.C: вместо $\cos(\pi/3)$ взят $\cos(\pi/6)$, и одно слагаемое потеряно

distractors_en.C: $\cos(\pi/6)$ was used instead of $\cos(\pi/3)$ and a term was dropped

question_en: What is the period of $x(t)=A\cos(3t+1)$, where $t$ is in seconds?
question_ru: Чему равен период колебания $x(t)=A\cos(3t+1)$ ($t$ — в секундах)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. ω = 3 rad/s, T = 2π/ω = 2π/3 s. Faza (+1) davrga ta'sir qilmaydi.
Asos: T = 2π/ω.

en: The angular frequency is the coefficient of $t$: $$\omega=3\ \mathrm{rad/s}$$

distractors_en.A: the period was taken as $1/\omega$, forgetting $2\pi$
distractors_en.B: $\omega/(2\pi)$ is the frequency $f$, not the period
distractors_en.C: $\omega$ itself was taken as the period

question_en: A detector is moved from $3\ \mathrm{m}$ to $9\ \mathrm{m}$ from a point source of light. The measured intensity changes by a factor of
question_uz: Detektor nuqtaviy yorug'lik manbaidan $3\ \mathrm{m}$ masofadan $9\ \mathrm{m}$ masofaga surildi. O'lchangan intensivlik necha marta o'zgaradi?
question_ru: Детектор переместили от точечного источника света с расстояния $3\ \mathrm{m}$ на $9\ \mathrm{m}$. Во сколько раз изменится измеренная интенсивность?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. I ∝ 1/r²: masofa 3 marta ortdi ⇒ I 9 marta kamaydi.
Asos: masofa kvadratiga teskari qonun.

distractors.A: intensivlik masofaga teskari proporsional deb olingan
distractors.C: masofa kubiga teskari proporsional deb olingan
distractors.D: intensivlik masofa bilan ortadi deb o'ylangan

distractors_ru.D: решили, что интенсивность растёт с расстоянием

distractors_en.A: the intensity was taken as inversely proportional to distance
distractors_en.C: taken as inversely proportional to the cube of the distance
distractors_en.D: assumed the intensity grows with distance

question_en: The height of a projectile is $h(t)=-5t^2+30t+2$ (meters, seconds). What is its maximum height?
question_uz: Jism balandligi $h(t)=-5t^2+30t+2$ (metr, sekund). Eng katta balandlik qancha?
question_ru: Высота тела $h(t)=-5t^2+30t+2$ (метры, секунды). Чему равна наибольшая высота?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Uchi t₀ = −30/(2·(−5)) = 3 s; h(3) = −45 + 90 + 2 = 47 m.
Asos: parabola uchi x₀ = −b/(2a).

question_en: A quantity decays as $N_0e^{-t/\tau}$. The time for it to fall to half its initial value is
question_uz: Kattalik $N_0e^{-t/\tau}$ qonun bo'yicha kamayadi. U boshlang'ich qiymatining yarmigacha kamayadigan vaqt
question_ru: Величина убывает по закону $N_0e^{-t/\tau}$. Время, за которое она уменьшится вдвое, равно
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. e^(−t/τ) = 1/2 ⇒ t/τ = ln 2 ⇒ t = τ ln 2 ≈ 0.69τ.
Asos: logarifm — eksponentaga teskari.

distractors.D: vaqt doimiysi va yarim yemirilish davri adashtirilgan

distractors_ru.D: перепутаны постоянная времени и период полураспада

distractors_en.D: the time constant and the half-life were confused

question_en: What is the maximum value of $3\cos x+4\sin x$?
question_uz: $3\cos x+4\sin x$ ning eng katta qiymati nechaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равно наибольшее значение $3\cos x+4\sin x$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. 3cos x + 4sin x = 5cos(x − δ), eng katta qiymati R = √(9+16) = 5.
Asos: R = √(a²+b²).

ru: Приводим к одному косинусу: $$3\cos x+4\sin x=5\cos(x-\delta)$$
en: Write as a single cosine: $$3\cos x+4\sin x=5\cos(x-\delta)$$
The maximum of the cosine is 1: $$\max=R=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$$

distractors.E: $\sin x$ va $\cos x$ bir vaqtda $1$ ga teng bo'la oladi deb o'ylangan

distractors_ru.E: решили, что $\sin x$ и $\cos x$ одновременно равны $1$

distractors_en.A: the difference of the coefficients was taken: $4-3$
distractors_en.B: only the $\cos x$ term was considered
distractors_en.C: the average of the coefficients was taken
distractors_en.E: assumed $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ can both equal $1$ at once
